**Why answer them again?** Pulling an answer back out of your memory, after a gap, is itself a way of learning it, not just a check (Roediger and Karpicke, 2006). To remember something for weeks, a gap of days between tries works better than a gap of minutes (Cepeda and colleagues, 2008). That is why this pass waits until after the ball.

**They come back again.** Two of these ideas open Module 2 as short look-back questions, and all twelve of the course's questions return at the end of Module 8, beside the answers you gave at the start.
